hero.title: Christian Festa

proofWall.title: Weeks → hours
proofWall.text: I design, architect, and code alongside AI coding agents and MCP. New features go from days or weeks to hours, and bug triage goes from hours to minutes.

proofWall.title: Automate first
proofWall.text: Automate when the steps are predictable. Use AI when the input is messy or takes judgment, and keep a human in the loop when a mistake would be costly. Multi-agent systems on Strands Agents and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore come in only when the problem calls for them.

proofWall.title: The entire delivery
proofWall.text: I’m responsible for the entire delivery, from requirements through release, with development, test, UX/UI design, and business analysis teams reporting to me through their leads.

proofWall.title: Idea → App Store
proofWall.text: I love this work, so I do it for myself too. I took Ghosty Privacy and Walkout Intros from idea to the App Store: the product, the design, the code, all of it.

hero.summary:
I work directly with customers to turn their ideas into working software, leading the teams that take it from first prototype through production. I run discovery with stakeholders, shape the scope and architecture, and stay accountable for the outcome after go-live. For {YEARS} years I've delivered mission-critical systems in government, healthcare, and criminal justice, where privacy, security, and compliance can't be an afterthought.

On AI work, my teams and I evaluate foundation models (LLMs) against the real use case, build RAG on the customer's own data, and create agents with the right prompts, tools, and guardrails. I translate between executives and engineers, and I set the standards and playbooks that make AI adoption stick. I'm a hands-on leader: I make the technical calls, review the work myself, and step in when the team needs it.

experience.title: Director of Software Engineering
experience.lead: Accountable for the design, development, and delivery of AI-enabled platforms across multiple programs.

bullets.text: Set technical vision and architecture with senior leaders and customers, turning goals into a delivery roadmap.

Lead delivery of a $40M DDI program on AWS as prime contractor and the customer’s technical lead, with up to 30+ people across front-end, back-end, test, UX/UI design, and business analysis, including an offshore subcontractor development team.
Direct secure generative AI delivery: RAG on Amazon Bedrock and a pgvector database, with layered guardrails and zero PII or IP exposure, cutting week-long work to hours.
Shape the architecture and contribute hands-on to a secure multi-agent AI system on Strands Agents, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, and Guardrails.
Established evals for AI in production, writing Python: baseline question sets to compare foundation models (Claude, Amazon Nova, Grok), run manually and by an AI agent.
Delivered an internal monitoring console, writing Python, that brings together traces (CloudWatch, AgentCore observability), response times, and token usage to estimate cost.

Lead adoption and governance of AI coding agents: coding standards they must follow, adherence to Figma designs and the design system, and AI-powered pull request reviews with a person making the final call.
Define engineering standards for quality, testing, and CI/CD across teams, and hold teams accountable to delivery and quality metrics.
Established the responsible-AI governance that lets teams move fast and stay compliant.
Built the team: personally interviewed nearly all of its 30+ members using a technical exercise and code walkthrough I created, then set goals and mentored engineers and team leads.
Manage program budget and staffing, including scaling a 30+ team down to a small team as the program moved toward handoff, and take part in build-versus-buy decisions.
Lead a multi-tenant platform hosting a portfolio of products on shared infrastructure.

projects.name: Ghosty Privacy
projects.description: A privacy firewall that lives on your phone. Ghosty stops the trackers, analytics, and telemetry your apps send in the background, across every app on the device, not just the browser. See what your apps look up, switch whole categories off with one tap, and pause it whenever you like. No account, no server: what Ghosty sees stays on your phone.

projects.name: Walkout Intros
projects.description: Pro-quality walkout intros for sports teams. Build a roster, pair each player with one of five AI announcer voices and a song cued to the drop, then run game day with one tap. Eleven sports, Apple Music or your own library.
